summary: High Court issued a conditional/interim order requiring the government to justify the Police Ordinance amendment that expanded the national security minister's police-policy powers.
notes: Do not create a separate accountability event. LEAD-2022-0004 already tracks the Police Ordinance Amendment No. 37 from enactment through the later January 2025 final High Court disposition, including the partial invalidation of section 8D and preservation of broader general-policy powers subject to police professional independence. The June 18, 2023 order is procedural history within that same legal challenge, not a distinct merits finding.
